npcRoster.name: Jakk Cabot
npcRoster.publicDescription: Jakk Cabot is a Verdan noble scholar whose charm, wealth, and academic curiosity orbit one terrible family secret. He studies ancient relics, longevity rites, psychic artifacts, and ichor-serum stabilizers while insisting that imprisoning a dangerous patriarch is stewardship rather than fear. Jakk is urbane, generous, and evasive, especially when the truth would reveal how many lives his family's research has consumed.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Frostfen is a Village in Nalvessir, under Communalism, with moderate danger, Beach and reefs with water, Beach and grass with water terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Verdan reads through the Verdan entry of the race compendium, within Orcs, Goblins, and Goblinoid Kin, marked by Enkirael. Fey-transformed humanoids who rapidly adapt physically and mentally as they age. They are resilient survivors with an unusually optimistic perspective on change. Table cues: +1 Constitution, +2 Charisma, Black Blood Healing, Limited Telepathy; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
publicRumors: Jakk has not aged correctly for a very long time, and neither have his household ledgers.
His kindest grants often go to scholars researching prisons, curses, or impossible lifespans.

npcRoster.name: Pearl Softstep
npcRoster.publicDescription: Pearl Softstep is a courteous Autognome hotel investigator with immaculate manners, a detective’s patience, and a talent for making murder suspects underestimate the furniture. At the Frostfen Archive, she assists the Choral Synod by investigating hotel deaths, inheritance puzzles, missing guests, and suspiciously well-preserved secrets in old resort ledgers. npcRoster.publicDescription:
Gloria No-Chain is a fierce, blunt, combat-ready Feral Tiefling who was once treated like property and now makes it everyone’s problem when anyone else is treated the same. She is sarcastic, impatient with soft excuses, and terrifying in a fight, but her anger is rooted in loyalty: she believes escapees, constructs, Soulbounds, ichor-marked victims, and rewritten people all deserve freedom, not “proper handling.”

She especially hates missions that force her to destroy controlled or unfinished artificial beings, because to Gloria, even the roughest-made person deserves a chance to be more than the purpose someone built into them.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
